name: navi
description: Experimental task-scope records, bounded independent review, Agent advisories and user-selected text rollback for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight scope supervision with evidence reports.
interface.longDescription: Keeps cited task and phase memory. Optional asynchronous Luna reviews share a bounded budget and advise the executing Agent without blocking. Explicit file checks and optional historical local tool/plan checks remain experimental. User reports preserve uncertainty; selected text rollback requires a reviewed preview and user confirmation. No automatic rollback.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Navi to monitor task scope and report findings. Do not block execution or automatically roll back changes.
